benchmarks.config: Read by eye off the card's benchmark figure (multi-panel bar grid); +/-0.5 at this resolution. notes: Created from the 2026-10-19 HuggingFace discovery crawl. Benchmarks are the card's own published rows (vendor claims). architecture and task are inferred from the slug and param ratio; KV geometry, context length and quant sizes are not yet filled, hence status draft. KV basis: 8 of 30 layers keep a KV cache (config layer_types: 8 full_attention, 22 conv). 8 x 8 KV heads x 64 head_dim x 2 (K and V) x 2 B = 16,384 B/token (16.0 KiB). head_dim absent from config.json: hidden_size 2048 / 32 heads = 64. The 22 conv layers hold a fixed-size convolution state (conv_L_cache 3) that does not grow with sequence length, so they add no per-token KV. REVIEWED 2026-10-21: card confirms every claimed row. Card benchmark table matches all 7 rows.
